Wenn ein Sklav Götzen opfert, büsse er [dem Herrn] 6 Schll. oder seine Haut.
If a slave sacrifices to idols, let him pay [to his lord] 6 shillings or his hide.
If a slave makes offerings to devils, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation or undergo the lash.
If a slave sacrifices to devils, he is to pay six shillings compensation or be flogged.
If a slave makes offering to devils, let him pay 6 shillings or his hide.
